The bird in the foreground is in a dynamic display posture, fanning its tail to reveal prominent white undertail coverts and curving its outer tail feathers outward (lyre shape). It has glossy black plumage with visible iridescence. A second blackcock is visible in the background to the right, showing a red eyebrow comb. Both birds exhibit feathered legs.
